newsitem.title: FRANCE: Global voice for Europe depends on unity - Chirac.
newsitem.headline: Global voice for Europe depends on unity - Chirac.

text.p: European nations will have a major say in international diplomacy only if they learn to work together on foreign policy and defence, French President Jacques Chirac said on Wednesday.

"Europeans will have an impact on world affairs only if they know how to combine their efforts within the framework of shared and ambitious foreign and defence policies. This is one of France's priorities," Chirac said.

The conservative Chirac, who last week began sharing power with a leftist government led by Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin, spoke at a ceremony honouring Carl Bildt, the former High Representative to Bosnia for the international community.
Chirac made Bildt a commander in the Legion of Honour, France's national order, for his efforts in Bosnia-Herzegovina.
Europe came under criticism during years of fighting in the former Yugoslavia for failing to take strong united action to bring peace to the region.

Chirac praised Bildt for his "clear vision of the goal to be attained, the affirmation of a united, multicultural and democratic Bosnia-Herzegovina at the heart of a stabilised region to which Europe must offer its hand".

"Rest assured of France's willingness to do all it can along this difficult path to ensure that peace takes root," Chirac said. Bildt, a former Swedish prime minister, stepped down from his Bosnia post on May 30 and was replaced by former Spanish foreign minister Carlos Westendorp.
